caption:
A widely cited sales-response study tracked thousands of B2B leads to see how contact speed affects deals.

Leads contacted within an hour converted nearly 7x more often than leads contacted later, according to research published in Harvard Business Review.

Same offer. Same price. Same rep. The only thing that moved was time.

Most service businesses never get close to responding that fast. Time your own response for a week and you'll see exactly where you stand.

rationale: Replaces an unverifiable invented study (fictional company, fabricated sample size and percentages) with a real, citable, widely referenced HBR finding on speed-to-lead conversion. Keeps the carousel's depth-for-saves structure while making every claim defensible.
